title: Rerun matched: WaveTrend extreme-cross bounce vs an ATR-decile-matched baseline, BTCUSDT + ETHUSDT USD-M futures 1m / 5m / 15m

what.name: Entry
what.value_plain: same events as wt-extreme-cross: buy wt1 crosses up with wt1 <= -50, sell crosses down with wt1 >= +40; event-bar close, 10-bar window

what.name: Baseline

what.label: OURS

how: Focal cells: POOL buy, 1m and 15m x HTF against and prior_trend = 4 cells, matched excess one-sided, Holm m = 4; BTC futures reproduce the shipped spot event counts within 1 per cell.
window: DEV 2022-01-01..2024-06-30 BTCUSDT + ETHUSDT futures 1m; VALIDATION and HOLDOUT not read

verdict.label: VOLATILITY-ONLY: the HTF-against / prior-trend bounce excess (+0.04 to +0.25 % unmatched) falls to -0.046 to +0.013 % against a same-ATR-decile baseline; 0 of 4 focal cells pass Holm, all with 269+ days. Fee-net below zero in 161 of 162 cells at 0.10 %.
